propose: # Gate 2 smoke run — built-in loss constraint (issue #112 workaround)

This chain is a Gate 2 framework smoke, not exploration. Its purpose is to validate the HealthGate infrastructure end-to-end. For that, the chain must complete at least one training round, which requires a loss that actually loads at runtime.

**Custom losses are currently blocked** by a phantom-Branch-B path (issue #112 — loss-implementor bug): the capability index advertises losses whose files live in old run-workspaces, not in `agent_generated/losses/`. Any Branch B or Branch C loss will fail at runtime with `Custom loss X not found in LOSS_REGISTRY or agent_generated/losses/`.
**MANDATORY LOSS CONSTRAINT for every proposal in this run:**
- Set `baseline_config.loss_config.loss_type` to exactly one of: `"focal"`, `"focal_cw"`, `"ce"`, or `"smooth_l1"`.
**MODEL surface is unconstrained** — you may propose new (Branch C) or reuse (Branch B) any model in the registry. The model side has a working phantom filter; only the loss side is broken.
This constraint applies only to this smoke run and is NOT for v17 production.
